recipe.loss: Unchanged TRAIN-only signed4 encoding, all original nodes MSE/4. Each chunk weighted by its node count over N; one optimizer update per whole case.
recipe.case_order: Existing PythonRandom2026 shuffled120 case keys for four passes;480 stored updates; each known3 case exposed four times, independent of model RNG.
recipe.geometry_input: One shared1024 original cloud-index replay per canonical CAD: xyz3+nonforce19 features=22; current force/moment slots7:13 excluded; same BC22 encoder64/global32 for both arms.
recipe.query_input: Original xyz plus nonforce19 local features and explicit global32; u basis independent of actual force6. Stress branch sees actual normalized load6 separately.
recipe.u_units: Zero-centered V[k,j]=B[k,j]/existing std_j; alpha from normalized load6 verified basis; encoded_u=sum(alpha*V)-mean/std once; physical_u=std*sum(alpha*V).
recipe.stress: Independent head with actual normalized force/moment6; unchanged signed scalar asinh encoding, no stress superposition claim.
recipe.architecture_comparison: DeepONet branch/trunk contraction vs local concatMLP with common BC22/cloud/scaler/factorization/protocol; heads/counts differ and are disclosed. Common encoder constructor/seed only; no whole-model equal-init/equal-capacity claim.
recipe.gradient: BC cloud encoded once per case. Detach global32 to a leaf, accumulate exact node-weighted head/query gradients for all chunks, then context.backward(leaf.grad) once through original encoder graph. No cloud recoding per chunk or cross-step context reuse.
recipe.selection: Fixed480 primary; common knownVAL15 score0.5*(case-mean U relativeL2+signedstress relativeL2), validation-best secondary; no training-best or dia-based selection.
recipe.timing: Primary train_seconds begins before ordinary selection load_case+BCcloud read/H2D and ends after complete allnode update/Adam/sync. New45CAD BCcloud preparation cost/coverage retained separately and is not hidden in model train cost. Inference timed after normal input/H2D; evaluationwall includes input loads. Overlapping cost fields are not summed. Raw runwall includes model startup/evaluation/checkpoint IO.
recipe.precision: Same float32/TF32/high/noautocast as existing screen; physical scalerdecode/metrics float64.

input_read_policy.arrays: Canonical ver cached xyz/features/cloud/mask only; fallback source NPZ xyz/faces/sample_key only

bc_cloud_contract.identity_algorithm: exact sorted FP32 rows; reject any multiple row match; missing only may replay pinned original sampler, never tolerance search

configuration.encoder_activation: ReLU; non-affine LN32 and tanh at output
configuration.capacity_policy: Different heads/parameter counts; no width/rank sweep or strict capacity matching

model.backend: PyTorch real FP32 trainables; no native/hash/FNO dependency
model.parameter_count_policy: Actual public real trainable numel; buffers excluded; architectures intentionally differ

geometry_encoder.input: xyz3 then original nonforce19 in canonical selected-node order
geometry_encoder.index_identity: New target-free data helper must verify true original cloud node indices/xyz identity and record BC-role coverage; no nearest-node copy or resampling

query_schema.query22: xyz3 followed by features0:7 and features13:25
query_schema.load6: Separate normalized global features7:13 = F/42300N and M/565000Nmm

output_schema.basis_units: V[k,j]=physical basis displacement B[k,j] / frozen TRAIN std_j; zero-centered basis, not individually centered encoded fields
output_schema.u_composition: encoded_u_j=sum_k alpha_k V_kj - mean_j/std_j once; physical_u_j=std_j sum_k alpha_k V_kj
output_schema.stress: Independent nonlinear real-load-conditioned head outputs shared signed-scalar asinh encoding; never scalar linear superposition

model.initialization_policy: Same seed and encoder created first gives common encoder initialization; heads, full-model initialization/counts differ, so no complete parameter equality or strict capacity causal claim
model.context_gradient: All query encoder dependence is the explicit ctx argument; no detached hidden state or train-time descriptor cache
model.gradient_policy: Finite positive aggregate encoder/trunk/u-head/stress-head gradients at first actual step; one-hot inactive basis output rows may be zero

sources.adaptation: New PyTorch geometry/BC set-branch + nine-response basis implementation; not a copied official preset or fixed-sensor DeepONet reproduction

limitations: Original nonforce19 off-node extension is undefined; no native continuous/PDE/BC acceptance
Discrete roles/current1024 sampling may omit interface points; no covert coverage repair
Low rank is a capacity constraint, not a demonstrated error cause
Only verified rank3 load span, not arbitrary six-load response
Signed scalar stress has unknown constitutive recovery semantics
No old-final or sealed new-test input/target read in model

config.initialization: Fresh both arms: same common BC encoder constructor/seed; distinct solver heads/layout/counts, no whole-model initialization or capacity equality claim
